title: Minor groove binding of imidocarb dipropionate to calf thymus DNA: insights from multispectral, thermodynamic, and molecular docking approaches
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49679-49688
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07575K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuxin Yu, Wanxin Luo, YiWen Zhong, Dongfang Li, Sen Wang, Yidan Bai, Junlong Zhao, Lan He
This study aimed to investigate the interaction between dipropionate (IMDP) and double-stranded DNA, as understanding its mechanism of action is crucial for optimizing its use as a veterinary antiprotozoal agent.
